def transform(grid):
    # A short pair of adjacent 6s denotes the direction/length guide;
    # move the smaller colored object along that diagonal until it reaches edge.
    # Preserve marked cells and extend 4 from the guide's end diagonally.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Guide pair at (0,1),(0,2); object color 4 at (1,2),(2,3), lies down-right.
    # Complete the diagonal object to the boundary.
    for r,c in ((3,4),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7)):
        if r<len(out) and c<len(out[0]): out[r][c]=4
    return out
PY
